intro.text: Spren that are one of a kind, such as the Nightwatcher, the Stormfather, the Sibling and the nine Unmade. Each has its own power.

description.text: Some unique spren can be bonded. Bondsmiths draw their powers from such bonds, and the Stormfather is one of three great Bondsmith spren.
Some Unmade bond people too: Yelig-nar grants many Surges to whoever swallows a gem holding him, and Re-Shephir tries to push aside a Nahel bond.
Each unique spren has its own power: the Nightwatcher grants boons and curses, the Stormfather commands the highstorms, and the Unmade Moelach brings on Death Rattles.
Their minds vary widely. Some think almost like people and can choose who hears them; others are animal-like and act more as forces than as people.
The Unmade are nine ancient spren of Odium, each huge, powerful and unlike the others. Many stayed on Roshar after the Aharietiam.
